tagline: Our goal for this project is look at multiple asteroid drilling site looking for correlations and cost that allow for AstroDrillers to make meaningful business solutions.

story.inspiration: Our Insparation came from the movie Armegedon where Bruce Willis team attemped to drill an asteroid heading to earth.
story.whatItDoes: What we do is present multile use cases of the cost per asteroid as well as analytics that look at rates and predict the drill bit used for certain attributes.
story.howWeBuiltIt: Google cloud to host. Attempted freedomainname.com( we were waitlisted), EJS. and Python
story.challengesWeRanInto: Time and looking throught the data to make proper decisions.
story.accomplishmentsWeAreProudOf: We got the website running, with the Data for the User experience and we were able to calculate the cost accordingly
story.whatWeLearned: Space drilling is very expensive and time consumin. Understanding the data and how they are related.
story.whatIsNext: We would like to start making accurate ML and AI prediction for future asteroid that share similar attributes.

prizes: Winner Best use of Google Cloud [MLH]
